# Literal spline source

`open-cubic.dxf` is independently hand-authored for this slice, not generated by
the snapshot serializer or CAD writer. It describes one open nonperiodic,
nonrational cubic with four XYZ control points `(0,0,0), (1,2,0), (2,2,0),
(3,0,0)` and knots `[0,0,0,0,1,1,1,1]`. Coordinates use millimetres; CAD version
is AC1032. Minimal DXF framing relies on the production reader's standard tables
and ownership scaffolding, independently verified by the exchange tests.

The fixture seeds verification, not an input whitelist. Additional owner/variant
cases are built directly as CadDocument values and compared against the same
direct writer/reader chain. Unsupported writing does not invalidate typed capture.
